sources.snippet: A 3D ViT-L encoder for volume microscopy (electron and expansion microscopy) at 8 nm. It has the DINOv3 ViT-L architecture with 8 × 8 × 8-voxel patches. Its weights started from Meta's 2D DINOv3 ViT-L/16 checkpoint (trained on LVD-1689M), inflated to 3D, and were then pretrained for 100k steps ...
